title: RigidBody3D does not follow its parent RigidBody under seemingly unrelated conditions
body:
### Tested versions

All observations made in 4.6.3.stable using Jolt physics
Confirmed most basic cases in 4.7.beta5

### System information

Windows 10 - Godot v4.6.3.stable

### Issue description

RigidBody3D, along with other PhysicsBody3D like AnimatableBody, appear extremely unreliable in following their parent RigidBody. They seem to consistently follow their parent transform only when set to static, and in other cases it seems very random and related to the presence of other objects in the scene, even when they do not interact at all. This is incredibly weird to me, as I thought it was common-ish practice to attach kinematic RigidBodies to a parent RB, but I cannot get it to work consistently.

The most basic case that I have observed would be: 
**"If there exists a rigidbody with more than one child that is a non-static-frozen rigibody, then all rigidbodies stop following their parent (whether they are kinematic or unfrozen)"**

I am honestly at a loss for words after testing a lot of simple cases (leading to **many** contradicting conclusions), so I have included a few basic scenes with observations and weird behavior when adding an object or changing a property in the scene.

### Steps to reproduce

Observed behavior in the included scenes:

### test_min
no children follow

**Variations:**
- set Process=disabled on any of the child RigidBodies -> all children follow correctly
- enable freeze (static) on any of the child RB -> same result, all children follow correctly
- set Node3D.topLevel: On on cubparent.cubR -> only cubR starts following after 1 second ?? (not because of collision, tried pushing children further away)


### test_min_static
cubparent2.child is now frozen (static)
all children follow correctly

- if you unset static freeze **at runtime**, all children keep following
- if you start without freeze, then enable freeze at runtime, all children start following
- also works the same if both cubparent children are kinematic
- (cubparent2.child set to kinematic freeze does nothing)

### test_min_static2
now 2 parent RBs with a static frozen child
this time, non-frozen RBs do not follow

=> only frozen static RBs follow their parent

### test_min_anim
cubparent2.child is now Animatablebody3D

- if sync_to_physics is true, all children start following after 1 second ??
- if sync_to_physics is false, only the Animatable follows

### test_min_anim_plusone
duplicated cubparent2, changed the child back to a rigidbody, this one never follows
unless you duplicate the cubparent3.childRb, now both cubparent3 children follow from the start
=> nevermind, I tried again and now only the new child follows (from the start), even though both children are identical
=> the new child only follows the parent if it is moved above it, not if it is further on the left. I am losing my mind honestly.


Disabled RBs always follow.

Using DEFAULT physics, seems broken as well but different:
RBs never follow, Animatables follow from the start

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[phys-parent-test.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/28685461/phys-parent-test.zip)
